slot.brief: Identify the carbonyl fragments obtained on reductive ozonolysis of a substituted alkene.

stem:
Reductive ozonolysis of 3-methylpent-2-ene with $

\text{O}_3$, followed by $

\text{Zn}/\text{H}_2\text{O}$, gives which pair of products?

verdicts.working: Cleavage of the C2=C3 bond gives ethanal from the carbon bearing H and butan-2-one from the carbon bonded to methyl and ethyl groups.

working:
$

\text{CH}_3\text{CH=C(CH}_3\text{)CH}_2\text{CH}_3$
$

\xrightarrow[\text{Zn}/\text{H}_2\text{O}]{\text{O}_3}$ cleavage at $

\text{C=C}$
$

\longrightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CHO} + \text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_2\text{CH}_3$
Products: ethanal and butan-2-one.

Independent check: Cleavage of the C2=C3 bond gives ethanal from the carbon bearing H and butan-2-one from the carbon bonded to methyl and ethyl groups.
solution:
Reductive ozonolysis cleaves the $\mathrm{C=C}$ bond, converting each alkene carbon into a carbonyl carbon.
$$\mathrm{CH_3CH=C(CH_3)CH_2CH_3 \xrightarrow[Zn/H_2O]{O_3} CH_3CHO + CH_3COCH_2CH_3}$$
The products are ethanal and butan-2-one.

C incorrectly divides the five-carbon alkene into two three-carbon fragments.
